segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra, 
saying: 'Verily, when I created Mithra, the lord of 
 
wide pastures, O Spitama! I created him as worthy 
of sacrifice, as worthy of prayer as myself, Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達向斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉說道：「確實，斯皮塔瑪啊，當我創造了廣牧之主密特拉的時候！我創造了他，使其配得祭禮，配得禱告，如同我阿胡拉‧馬茲達一樣。」

segments.orig:
mereñcaite vîspãm dainghaom
mairyô mithrô-druxsh spitama,
ýatha satem kayadhanãm
avavat ashava-jacit,
mithrem mâ janyå spitama
mâ ýim drvatat peresånghe
mâ ýim hvâdaênât ashaonat,
vayå zî asti mithrô
drvataêca ashaonaêca.
segments.en:
'The ruffian who lies unto Mithra brings death 
unto the whole country, injuring as much the faithful 
world as a hundred evil-doers could do. Break not 
the contract, O Spitama! neither the one that thou 
hadst entered into with one of the unfaithful, nor the 
one that thou hadst entered into with one of the 
faithful who is one of thy own faith. For Mithra 
stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful.
segments.zh: 「對密特拉說謊的惡棍為全國帶來死亡，所傷害的信心世界如同百個惡行者所能做的一樣多。斯皮塔瑪啊，不要違背誓約！既不違背你與無信者所立的誓約，也不違背你與同信者所立的誓約。因為密特拉同時為無信者和有信者而立。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, gives swiftness 
to the horses of those who lie not unto 
Mithra.
'Fire, the son of Ahura Mazda, gives the straightest 
way to those who lie not unto Mithra.
'The good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the 
faithful give a virtuous offspring to those who lie 
not unto Mithra.
segments.zh:
「廣牧之主密特拉賦予那些不對密特拉說謊的人的馬匹以迅捷。
阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子火焰為那些不對密特拉說謊的人指引最直的道路。
善良、強大、恩惠的信者弗拉瓦希為那些不對密特拉說謊的人賜予德行的後嗣。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto 
him a sacrifice worth being heard, namely, unto 
Mithra, the lord of wide pastures.
'We offer up libations unto Mithra, the lord of 
wide pastures, who gives a happy dwelling and a 
good dwelling to the Aryan nations.
segments.zh:
「為了他的光輝和榮耀，我將向他獻上值得被聽聞的祭禮，即獻給廣牧之主密特拉。
我們向廣牧之主密特拉獻上奠酒，他為雅利安民族賜予幸福的住所和善良的住所。」

segments.en:
'May he come to us for help! May he come 
to us for ease! May he come to us for joy! May 
he come to us for mercy! May he come to us for 
health! May he come to us for victory! May he 
 
come to us for good conscience! May he come to 
us for bliss! he, the awful and overpowering, worthy 
of sacrifice and prayer, not to be deceived anywhere 
in the whole of the material world, Mithra, the lord
of wide pastures.
segments.zh: 「願他為我們而來以求助！願他為我們而來以求安樂！願他為我們而來以求喜悅！願他為我們而來以求仁慈！願他為我們而來以求健康！願他為我們而來以求勝利！願他為我們而來以求良好的心智！願他為我們而來以求福樂！他，可怕而凌駕一切，配得祭禮和禱告，在整個物質世界中任何地方都不能被欺騙，廣牧之主密特拉。」

segments.en:
'I will offer up libations unto him, the strong 
Yazata, the powerful Mithra, most beneficent to the 
creatures: I will apply unto him with charity and 
prayers: I will offer up a sacrifice worth being heard 
unto him, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, with the 
Haoma and meat, with the baresma, with the wisdom 
of the tongue, with the holy spells, with the 
speech, with the deeds, with the libations, and with 
the rightly-spoken words.
'Yenhe hatam: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda....
segments.zh:
「我將向他獻上奠酒，強大的亞扎塔，有力的密特拉，對造物最恩惠的神：我將以慈悲和禱告而向他祈求：我將獻上值得被聽聞的祭禮給他，廣牧之主密特拉，用豪麻和肉，用巴雷斯瑪，用舌之智慧，用聖言，用言語，用行為，用奠酒，以及用正語。
『永願如是：所有這些阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造之生靈……』」

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide 
pastures, who is truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, 
with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with ten thousand eyes, 
high, with full knowledge, strong, sleepless, 
and ever awake;
segments.zh: 「我們祭祀廣牧之主密特拉，他說真話，在集會中是首領，有千隻耳朵，塑形完美，有萬隻眼睛，高尚，具足智慧，強大，不眠，永遠清醒。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'To whom the chiefs of nations offer up sacrifices, 
as they go to the field, against havocking hosts, 
against enemies coming in battle array, in the strife 
of conflicting nations.
segments.zh: 「各族的首領們向他獻上祭禮，當他們去戰場時，對抗掠奪之師，對抗排陣而來的敵人，在衝突民族的爭鬥中。」

segments.en:
'On whichever side he has been worshipped 
first in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart, to that 
side turns Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, with 
the fiend-smiting wind, with the cursing thought 
of the wise.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
「無論在何處，以虔誠之心的圓滿信仰被首先敬拜，密特拉，廣大牧地的主宰，就轉向那一方，帶著克魔的風，帶著聖賢的詛咒之念。
為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……」

segments.en:
'Whom the horsemen worship on the back 
of their horses, begging swiftness for their teams, 
health for their own bodies, and that they may watch 
with full success those who hate them, smite down
their foes, and destroy at one stroke their adversaries, 
their enemies, and those who hate them.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
「騎士們在馬背上敬拜他，乞求他們的馬隊迅捷，他們自身的身體健康，並願他們能以完全的成功觀看那些恨他們的人，擊倒他們的敵人，並一擊毀滅他們的對手、他們的仇敵、以及那些恨他們的人。
為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……」

segments.en:
'Who first of the heavenly gods reaches over 
the Hara, before
the undying, swift-horsed sun; 
 
who, foremost in a golden array, takes hold of the 
beautiful summits, and from thence looks over the 
abode of the Aryans with a beneficent eye.
segments.zh:
「天神中最先越過哈拉山的，在不朽的、善騎馬的太陽之前；
最先穿著金色盔甲，掌握著美麗的山峰者，並從此處以善眼俯視雅利安人的居所。」

segments.zh: 「英勇的首領在此集結他們的眾多軍隊；高大的山岳在此，富饒牧草與水源，為牲畜提供豐足；深邃的湖泊在此，鹹水立存；寬闊流動的河流在此，洶湧奔向伊什卡塔與普魯塔、莫魯與哈羅尤、高瓦─蘇格達與赫瓦里澤姆；」

segments.en:
'On Arezahi and Sawahi, on Fradadhafshu 
and Widadhafshu, on Wouru-bareshti and Wourujareshti, 
on this bright karshwar of Xwaniratha, the abode 
of cattle, the dwelling of cattle, the powerful Mithra 
looks with a health-bringing eye;
segments.zh: 「在阿雷札希與薩瓦希、弗拉達哈夫舒與維達哈夫舒、沃魯─巴雷什提與沃魯─賈雷什提、在此明亮的赫瓦尼拉塔地域上，牲畜的居所，牲畜的住處，強大的密特拉以帶來健康的眼光俯視；」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'He who moves along all the karshwars, a 
Yazata unseen, and brings glory; he who moves 
along all the karshwars, a Yazata unseen, and 
brings sovereignty; and increases strength for 
 
victory to those who, with a pious intent, holily 
offer him libations.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth 
being heard....
segments.zh:
「他遍行所有地域，一位無形的亞扎塔，帶來榮耀；他遍行所有地域，一位無形的亞扎塔，帶來主權；並為那些以虔誠之意，聖潔地獻上奠酒給他的人增加勝利的力量。
為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, .... 
sleepless, and ever awake;
'Unto whom nobody must lie, neither the master 
of a house, nor the lord of a borough, nor the lord 
of a town, nor the lord of a province.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣大草地的主人，……無眠者，永遠清醒者；
誰都不能向他撒謊，既不是家戶之主，也不是鄉邑之主，也不是城鎮之主，也不是省份之主。

segments.en:
'If the master of a house lies unto him, or the 
lord of a borough, or the lord of a town, or the lord 
of a province, then comes Mithra, angry and offended, 
and he breaks asunder the house, the borough, the 
town, the province; and the masters of the houses, 
the lords of the boroughs, the lords of the towns, 
the lords of the provinces, and the foremost men 
of the provinces.
segments.zh: 若家戶之主向他撒謊，或鄉邑之主，或城鎮之主，或省份之主，那麼密特拉來臨，怒而被觸怒，他摧毀了家戶、鄉邑、城鎮、省份；以及家戶之主、鄉邑之主、城鎮之主、省份之主，和省份的首領人物。

segments.orig:

ýahmâi naêmanãm mithrô-druxsh

segments.en:
'On whatever side there is one who has lied 
unto Mithra, on that side Mithra stands forth, angry 
and offended, and his wrath is slow to relent.
segments.zh: 無論何方有人向密特拉撒謊，密特拉就在那一方站立出來，怒而被觸怒，他的憤怒遲緩於消退。

segments.en:
'Those who lie unto Mithra, however swift 
they may be running, cannot overtake; riding, 
cannot ....; driving, cannot ..... The spear that 
the foe of Mithra flings, darts backwards, for the
 
number of the evil spells that the foe of Mithra 
works out.
segments.zh: 那些向密特拉撒謊的人，無論他們跑得多快，也追不上；騎馬時，追不上；駕車時，追不上。密特拉之敵所擲的長矛往後飛去，因為密特拉之敵所施展的邪惡咒法之數。

even though it reach the body, it makes no wound, 
for the number of the evil spells that the foe of 
Mithra works out. The wind drives away the 
spear that the foe of Mithra flings, for the number 
of the evil spells that the foe of Mithra works out.

being heard....
segments.zh:

為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣大草地的主人，……無眠者，永遠清醒者；
他將未向他撒謊的人從困厄中救出，將他從死亡中救出。

segments.en:
'Take us out of distress, take us out of distresses, 
O Mithra! as we have not lied unto thee. 
Thou bringest down terror upon the bodies of the 
men who lie unto Mithra; thou takest away the 
strength from their arms, being angry and all-powerful; 
thou takest the swiftness from their feet, the 
eye-sight from their eyes, the hearing from their 
ears.
segments.zh: 密特拉啊，將我們從困厄中救出，將我們從各種困厄中救出！因為我們未曾向你撒謊。你將恐懼降臨在向密特拉撒謊的人的身體上；你奪去他們手臂的力量，怒而全能；你奪去他們腳的速疾，眼睛的視力，耳朵的聽覺。

'Not the wound of the well-sharpened spear 
or of the flying
arrow reaches that man to whom Mithra comes for help with all
the strength of his soul, he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful,
all-seeing, undeceivable Mithra.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
設若密特拉以他靈魂的所有力量來幫助某人，那麼磨利的長矛或飛馳的箭的傷口都及不到那人。他是擁有一萬間諜的，強大的，見無不聞的，不可欺的密特拉。
為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.zh: 誰粉碎達埃瓦的頭顱，在加罪時最為殘酷；對向密特拉說謊的人施以懲罰，對抗派瑞卡；誰若未被欺騙，則以至高力量建立民族；誰若未被欺騙，則以至高勝利建立民族；

'Who confounds the ways of the nation that 
delights in havoc, who turns away their Glory, takes 
away their strength for victory, blows them away

strokes; he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, 
all-seeing, undeceivable Mithra.

being heard....
 
 VIII.
segments.zh: 誰使喜樂於破壞的民族迷茫其道，誰轉離他們的榮光，奪去他們勝利的力量，吹散他們無力無援，將他們交付於一萬次打擊；他，那一萬眾間諜者，強大的、無所不見的、不可欺騙的密特拉。為了他的亮光與榮光，我將獻給他一場值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.zh: 我們祭祀密特拉，廣大草地的主啊，……不眠者，永遠清醒者；誰支撐崇高殿舍的柱子，使其棟樑堅實；誰給予那被他滿足的殿舍以牛群與男孩；他摧毀那些得罪他的人。

segments.zh: 你啊，密特拉！對民族既是壞又是好；你啊，密特拉！對人既是壞又是好；你啊，密特拉！在你手中掌握民族的和平與困擾。

women, beautiful with chariots, with well-laid foundations, 
and high above their groundwork; thou 
makest that house lofty, beautiful with women, 
beautiful with chariots, with well-laid foundations, 
and high above its groundwork, of which the master, 
pious and holding libations in his hand, offers thee 
a sacrifice, in which thou art invoked by thy own 
name and with the proper words.
segments.zh: 你使殿舍廣大、以婦女美化、以戰車美化、基礎完善、高於其地面；你使那殿舍崇高、以婦女美化、以戰車美化、基礎完善、高於其地面，其主人虔誠而持奠祭在手，以祭祀奉祀你，其中以你的本名與正確的言語喚起你。

thee libations, O thou undeceivable Mithra!
segments.zh: 我以祭祀奉祀你，其中以你的本名與正確的言語喚起你，我將奉獻奠祭於你，啊強大的密特拉！我以祭祀奉祀你，其中以你的本名與正確的言語喚起你，我將奉獻奠祭於你，啊最大恩惠者密特拉！我以祭祀奉祀你，其中以你的本名與正確的言語喚起你，我將奉獻奠祭於你，啊不可欺騙者密特拉！

segments.en:
'Listen unto our sacrifice, O Mithra! Be 
thou pleased with our sacrifice, O Mithra! Come 
and sit at our sacrifice! Accept our libations! 
Accept them as they have been consecrated! 
Gather them together with love and lay them in 
the Garo-nmana!.
segments.zh: 聽我們的祭祀吧，密特拉啊！為我們的祭祀所悅吧，密特拉啊！來坐於我們的祭祀上！接納我們的奠祭！按其祝聖之状接納之！以摯愛聚集之，置之於加羅‧烏瑪那！

O powerful god! in accordance with the words of 
revelation, namely, riches, strength, and victory, 
good conscience and bliss, good fame and a good 
 
soul; wisdom and the knowledge that gives happiness, 
the victorious strength given by Ahura, the 
crushing Ascendant of Asha Vahishta, and conversation 
(with God) on the Holy Word.
segments.zh: 求賜我們這些恩賜，這些我們向汝乞求者，強大的神啊！依照啟示之言，即是：財富、力量與勝利，良善的良心與幸福，美好的名聲與美好的靈魂；智慧與給予幸福的知識，阿胡拉所賜的勝利之力，阿沙‧瓦希什塔的粉碎性上升，與聖言之對話。

Daevas and Men, of the Yatus and Pairikas, of the 
oppressors, the blind, and the deaf.

segments.zh:
求賜我們，以良善的精神與高貴的精神，喜悅中崇高，以良善的精神，得以擊殺我們的一切敵人；求賜我們，以良善的精神與高貴的精神，喜悅中崇高，以良善的精神，得以擊殺我們的一切仇敵；求賜我們，以良善的精神與高貴的精神，喜悅中崇高，以良善的精神，得以擊殺達埃瓦與人類、雅圖與佩里卡、壓迫者、盲者與聾者的一切惡意。
為其光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……

where abide men who lie unto Mithra, and, verily, 
the fiendish killer of faithful men. The grazing cow 
goes a sad straying way, driven along the vales of 
the Mithradrujes: they stand on the road, letting 
tears run over their chins.

strikes a counter-fear into them; the holy Sraosha 
blows them away from every side towards the two

the ranks of the army melt away, as Mithra, the lord

segments.zh: 密特拉令他們恐懼；拉什努對他們施以反制的恐懼；聖潔的斯魯沙從四面八方把他們吹向兩位亞扎塔，世界的維護者。他們使軍隊的隊伍消融，如同寬牧地的主人密特拉，憤怒、冒犯、不滿的樣子，前來迎戰他們。

'They cry unto Mithra, the lord of wide 
pastures, saying: "O Mithra, thou lord of wide pastures!

they flee from Mithra; here are our sturdy arms cut 
to pieces by the sword, O Mithra!"
segments.zh: 他們向寬牧地的主人密特拉呼救，說：「寬牧地的主人密特拉啊！我們熾烈的馬匹正帶著我們逃離，逃離密特拉；我們堅強的手臂被利劍砍成碎片，密特拉啊！」

their thousands and their tens of thousands, their

segments.zh:
我們向寬牧地的主人密特拉獻祭……不睡眠且永遠清醒的神；
他的住所廣闊如大地，延伸於物質世界之上，遼闊、無邊界、明亮，一處遠遠伸展開去的居所。

'Whose eight friends sit as spies for Mithra, 
on all the heights, at all the watching-places, observing 
the man who lies unto Mithra, looking at those, 
remembering those who have lied unto Mithra, but 
guarding the ways of those whose life is sought by 
 
men who lie unto Mithra, and, verily, by the fiendish 
killers of faithful men.
segments.zh: 他的八位友人坐著作為密特拉的間諜，在所有的高處，在所有的監視地點，觀察向密特拉說謊的人，看那些向密特拉說過謊的人，記得那些向密特拉說過謊的人，但保護那些被說謊的人所追殺的生命的道路，以及確實被邪惡的忠誠者的殺手所追殺的人。

segments.en:
'Helping and guarding, guarding behind and 
guarding in front, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, 
proves an undeceivable spy and watcher for the man 
to whom he comes to help with all the strength of 
his soul, he of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, 
all-knowing, undeceivable god.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
幫助與保護，背後保護與前面保護，寬牧地的主人密特拉，對他所幫助的人證實了一位不可欺騙的間諜與監視者，以其靈魂的所有力量，他是擁有萬名間諜的強大者，無所不知、不可欺騙的神。
因他的光亮與榮耀，我將向他獻上可被聽聞的祭禮……

'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....

enemies coming in battle array, in the strife of conflicting

segments.zh:
我們向寬牧地的主人密特拉獻祭……不睡眠且永遠清醒的神；
一位高名聞遐邇與長壽的神，寬蹄的馬匹載著他對抗掠奪的群眾，對抗在戰鬥陣列中來臨的敵人，在相爭的民族的戰爭之中。

'And when Mithra drives along towards the havocking hosts,
towards the enemies coming in battle array, in the strife of the
conflicting nations, then he binds the hands of those who have
lied unto Mithra, he confounds their eye-sight, he takes the 
hearing from their ears; they can no longer move 
their feet; they can no longer withstand those 
people, those foes, when Mithra, the lord of wide 
pastures, bears them ill-will.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
當密特拉馳向肆虐的軍勢時，
朝著排成戰鬥陣列的來臨的敵人，在該衝突之中
衝突的民族，然後他綑綁那些曾經

他們的耳朵聽不到；他們無法再移動
他們的腳；他們無法再承受那些
人們，那些敵人，當密特拉，廣闊的主人時
牧場，對它們懷有惡意。
'為他的光榮與榮耀，我將獻上值得的祭祀
被聽見....

segments.zh: 物質世界的造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達為他建造的住所，在哈拉‧貝雷扎提，那光明的山嶺，眾多（星辰）繞行其周，那裡既無夜晚也無黑暗，無寒冷之風也無炎熱之風，無致死之疾，無達埃瓦造成的不潔，雲層也無法抵達哈拉提‧巴雷扎；

segments.en:
'A dwelling that all the Amesha-Spentas, in 
one accord with the sun, made for him in the fulness

of the material world from the Haraiti Bareza.
segments.zh: 一個住所，所有的大天神與日光一致同心，以虔信之心的充盈，為他製造，他從哈拉提‧巴雷扎俯察整個物質世界。

segments.en:
'And when there rushes a wicked worker of 
evil, swiftly, with a swift step, Mithra, the lord of 
wide pastures, goes and yokes his horses to his 
chariot, along with the holy, powerful Sraosha and 
Nairyo-sangha, who strikes a blow that smites the 
army, that smites the strength of the malicious.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh: 當一個邪惡的行惡者匆匆而至，以迅速的步伐，廣闊牧場的主宰密特拉前往，將他的馬匹套在戰車上，與聖潔的、強大的斯魯沙和奈里約‧桑哈同行，他們施予打擊，摧毀軍隊，摧毀惡徒的力量。為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將向他獻祭，其祭品堪被聽聞……

segments.zh: 我們向廣闊牧場的主宰密特拉獻祭，……不眠不休，永遠清醒者；

segments.en:
'Who, with hands lifted up, ever cries unto 
Ahura Mazda, saying: "I am the kind keeper of all 
creatures, I am the kind maintainer of all creatures; 
yet men worship me not with a sacrifice in which 
I am invoked by my own name, as they worship the 
other gods with sacrifices in which they are invoked 
by their own names.
segments.zh: 他雙手高舉，永遠向阿胡拉‧馬茲達呼喊，說：「我是所有生物的良善守護者，我是所有生物的良善維持者；然而人們並未以呼喚我名字的祭祀來崇拜我，如同他們以呼喚其他諸神名字的祭祀來崇拜其他亞扎塔者一般。

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'"If men would worship me with a sacrifice 
 
in which I were invoked by my own name, as they 
worship the other Yazatas with sacrifices in which 
they are invoked by their own names, then I would 
come to the faithful at the appointed time; I would 
come in the appointed time of my beautiful, immortal 
life."
segments.zh: 「若人們以呼喚我名字的祭祀來崇拜我，如同他們以呼喚其他亞扎塔者名字的祭祀來崇拜其他亞扎塔者一般，則我將在約定之時來臨於信道者；我將在我美好、不朽生命的約定之時來臨。」

segments.en:
'But the pious man, holding libations in his 
hands, does worship thee with a sacrifice, in which 
thou art invoked by thy own name, and with the 
proper words.
'With a sacrifice, in which thou art invoked by thy 
own name, with the proper words will I offer thee 
libations, O powerful Mithra!
'With a sacrifice, in which thou art invoked by thy 
own name, with the proper words will I offer thee 
libations, O most beneficent Mithra!
'With a sacrifice, in which thou art invoked by thy 
own name, with the proper words will I offer thee 
libations, O thou undeceivable Mithra!
segments.zh:
但虔誠的人，手中持著祭酒在他
手中，確實敬拜你，以祭祀，在其中
你以自己的名字被呼喚，並與
適當的話語。

你的名字，以適當的話語，我將獻給你
祭酒，強大的密特拉啊！
'以祭祀，在其中你被你的名呼喚，你的
你的名，以適當的言辭，我將獻給你
祭酒，最有益的密特拉啊！
'以祭祀，在其中你被你的名呼喚，你的
你的名，以適當的言辭，我將獻給你
祭酒，啊！不可欺騙的密特拉！

segments.en:
'Listen unto our sacrifice, 'O Mithra! Be thou 
pleased with our sacrifice, O Mithra! Come and sit 
at our sacrifice! Accept our libations! Accept them 
as they have been consecrated! Gather them together 
with love and lay them in the Garo-nmana [Garothman i.e. Heaven]!
'Grant us these boons which we beg of thee, 
O powerful god! in accordance with the words of 
revelation, namely, riches, strength, and victory, 
good conscience and bliss, good fame and a good 
soul; wisdom and the knowledge that gives happiness, 
the victorious strength given by Ahura, the 
crushing Ascendant of Asha-Vahishta, and conversation 
(with God) on the Holy Word.
'Grant that we, in a good spirit and high spirit, 
exalted in joy and a good spirit, may smite all our 
foes; that we, in a good spirit and high spirit, 
exalted in joy and a good spirit, may smite all 
our enemies; that we, in a good spirit and high spirit, 
exalted in joy and a good spirit, may smite all the 
malice of Daevas and Men, of the Yatus and 
Pairikas, of the oppressors, the blind, and the deaf.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
'聆聽我們的祭祀，'O 密特拉！你要
高興於我們的祭祀，O 密特拉！來坐
在我們的祭祀！接受我們的祭酒！接受它們
把它們聚集在一起
帶著愛並將它們放在 Garo-nmana [Garothman i.e. Heaven]！
'賜予我們這些我們所乞求的恩典，
強大的神啊！按照……的話語
啟示，也就是，財富，力量，和勝利，
良心和福樂，良好名聲和一個好
靈魂；智慧和帶來幸福的知識，
阿胡拉所賜的勝利之力，
壓制阿沙‧瓦希什塔的升起，和交談
(與上帝) 在聖言上。
'授予我們，在良好精神和高尚精神，
在喜悅和良好精神中被高舉，願擊敗我們的所有
敵人；那我們，在良好精神和高尚精神，
在喜悅和良好精神中被高舉，願擊敗所有
我們的敵人；那我們，在良好精神和高尚精神，
在喜樂與善靈中被崇高，可擊敗一切
達埃瓦與人類的惡意，雅圖斯和
派莉卡斯，壓迫者的，盲人和聾人
'為他的光亮與榮耀，我將獻上價值
被聽見....

who has lied unto Mithra; who gives neither glory 
nor any boon to him who has lied unto Mithra.
segments.zh: 他不給向密特拉說謊的人賦予力量與氣力；他不給向密特拉說謊的人賦予榮光與任何恩賜。

segments.en:
'Thou takest away the strength from their 
arms, being angry and all-powerful; thou takest the 
swiftness from their feet, the eye-sight from their 
eyes, the hearing from their ears.
'Not the wound of the well-sharpened spear or of 
the flying arrow reaches that man to whom Mithra 
comes for help with all the strength of his soul, he, 
of the ten-thousand spies, the powerful all-knowing, 
undeceivable god.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer
him a sacrifice worth being heard....
segments.zh:
你在憤怒中、在全能中奪走他們臂膀的力量；你奪走他們雙腳的迅捷，奪走他們眼睛的視力，奪走他們耳朵的聽覺。
製作精良的矛傷或飛行箭矢的傷害，不會傷及那些蒙密特拉來助的人——他以全部心靈的力量而來，他是那位有萬千間諜、強大而全知、不可欺騙的神。
為了他的光輝與榮光，我將向他獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……

amongst the liberal, strong amongst the strong, a

awful cursing thought of the wise, the awful Fravashis 
of the faithful, and he who keeps united together

being heard....
segments.zh:
與他同行的有阿希（美德女神），以及帕倫迪乘著她的明亮戰車而來，可畏的男子氣概，可畏的王者榮光，可畏的至高天空，可畏的聰慧者的詛咒之念，可畏的信徒們的弗拉瓦希，以及那位使眾多馬茲達信徒緊聚在一起的者。

rathwya cithra hacimnô

verethrakhnaca ahuradhâta.
segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'Who drives along on his high-wheeled chariot, 
made of a heavenly substance, from the Karshvare [keshwar] 
of Arezahi to the Karshvare of Xwaniratha, the 
bright one; accompanied by the wheel of sovereignty, 
the Glory made by Mazda, and the Victory 
made by Ahura;
segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣大牧場的主宰，……不眠者，永遠清醒者；
他駕著由天體物質製成的高輪戰車而行，從阿雷札希卡爾什瓦爾行至光亮的胡瓦尼拉塔卡爾什瓦爾，伴隨著主權之輪、馬茲達所造的榮光，與阿胡拉所造的勝利。

segments.orig:
ýenghe vâshem hangrewnâiti
ashish vanguhi ýâ berezaiti
ýenghe daêna mâzdayasnish
hvîte pathô râdhaiti,
ýim aurvañtô mainyavånghô
aurusha raoxshna frâderesra
speñta vîdhvånghô asaya
manivasanghô vazeñti
ýat dim dâmôish upamanô
hu-irixtem bâdha irinaxti,
ýahmat haca fratereseñti
vîspe mainyava daêva
ýaêca varenya drvañtô.
segments.en:
'Whose chariot is embraced by the great 
Ashi Vanguhi; to whom the Law of Mazda opens a 
way, that he may go easily; whom four heavenly 
steeds, white, shining, seen afar, beneficent, endowed 
with knowledge, swiftly carry along the heavenly 
space, while the cursing thought of the wise pushes 
it forward;
segments.zh: 他的戰車被偉大的阿希所環抱；馬茲達之法為他開闢一條路，使他易於前行；四匹天馬——潔白、閃耀、遠見、有益、具知識之賦——迅速地將他沿著天域驅行，而聰慧者的詛咒之念推動著它向前；

segments.orig:
môi-tû ithra ahurahe
grañtahe vaêkhâi jasaêma
ýenghe hazangrem vaêkhanãm
paiti hamerethâi jasaiti
ýô baêvare-spasânô sûrô
vîspô-vîdhvå adhaoyamnô.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'From whom all the Daevas unseen and the 
Varenya fiends flee away in fear. Oh! may we 
 
never fall across the rush of the angry lord, who 
goes and rushes from a thousand sides against his 
foe, he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, 
all-knowing, undeceivable god.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
所有不見之達埃瓦與瓦雷尼亞魔鬼從他面前驚懼而逃。噢！願我們永遠不與這位憤怒之主相撞，他從千方百面奔衝而至、與其敵對抗爭——他是那位有萬千間諜、強大而全知、不可欺騙的神。
為了他的光輝與榮光，我將向他獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem
ýenghe paurva-naêmât vazaite
verethrakhnô ahuradhâtô
hû kehrpa varâzahe
paiti-erenô tizhi-dãstrahe
arshnô tizhi-asûrahe
hakeret-janô varâzahe
anu-pôithwahe grañtahe
parshvanikahe taxmahe ayanghô-pâdhahe ayanghô-zastahe
ayanghô-jyehe ayanghô-dumahe
ayanghô-paitishhvarenahe
segments.zh:
我們向寬闊牧場的主人密特拉獻祭，……無眠者，永遠清醒者；
在他面前，由阿胡拉所造的維雷特拉格納，化作野豬的形狀奔馳，對抗敵人——尖牙的公野豬，尖顎的野豬，一擊而殺，追逐著，憤怒的，滴血的面孔；
強壯的，鐵足、鐵前爪、鐵兵器、鐵尾、鐵顎；

segments.orig:
ýô frãshtacô hamerethâdha
upa-haxtô â-manangha
hathra nairya hãm-vareta
stija nijaiñti hamerethê
naêdha manyete jakhnvå
naêdha cim khenãm sadayeiti
ýavata aêm nijaiñti
merezuca stûnô gayehe
merezuca xå ushtânahe.
segments.en:
'Who, eagerly clinging to the fleeing foe, along 
with Manly Courage, smites the foe in battle, and 
does not think he has smitten him, nor does he 
consider it a blow till he has smitten away the 
marrow and the column of life, the marrow and 
the spring of existence.
segments.zh: 他急切地擁抱逃敵，與男性勇氣一同，在戰鬥中擊打敵人，卻不以為自己已擊中，也不視之為一擊，直到他擊去了骨髓和生命之柱、骨髓和存在之泉。

segments.orig:
hakat vîspå aipi-kereñtaiti ýô
hakat astêsca varesêsca mastarekhnasca vohunishca
zemâdha hãm-raêthwayeiti mithrô-drujãm
mashyânãm.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'He cuts all the limbs to pieces, and mingles, 
together with the earth, the bones, hair, brains, and 
blood of the men who have lied unto Mithra.
'For his brightness and glory, we offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
他將所有肢體砍成碎片，並將向密特拉說謊之人的骨頭、毛髮、腦髓、血液與土地混在一起。
為了他的光輝和榮耀，我們向他獻上值得被聽聞的祭禮……

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem
ýô bâdha ustânazastô
urvâzemnô avarôit vâcim uityaojanô,
ahura mazda mainyô
spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum
segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'Who, with hands lifted up, rejoicing, cries out, 
speaking thus:
segments.zh:
我們向寬闊牧場的主人密特拉獻祭，……無眠者，永遠清醒者；
他舉起雙手，欣喜地吶喊，如此發言：

segments.orig:
ýedhi-zî-mâ mashyâka aoxtô-nâmana
ýasna ýazayañta ýatha anye ýazatånghô
aoxtô-nâmana ýasna ýazeñti
frâ nuruyô ashavaoyô
thwarshtahe zrû âyû shûshuyãm
hvahe gayehe hvanvatô ameshahe
upa thwarshtahe jakhmyãm.
segments.en:
'"O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent spirit! 
Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!
'"If men would worship me with a sacrifice in 
which I were invoked by my own name, as they 
worship the other gods with sacrifices in which they 
are invoked by their own names, then I should 
come to the faithful at the appointed time; I should 
come in the appointed time of my beautiful, immortal 
life."
segments.zh:
「阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，最仁慈的善靈啊！物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！
「如果人類以包含我名字的祭禮向我獻祭，就像他們以包含其他亞扎塔名字的祭禮向它們獻祭一樣，那麼我就應當在約定的時間來到信徒身邊；我應當在我美麗的、不朽的生命的約定時間內到來。」

segments.orig:
buyama tê shôithrô-pânô
mâ buyama shôithrô-iricô mâ nmânô-iricô
mâ vîsô-iricô mâ zañtu-iricô
mâ dainghu-iricô
mâdha ýat nô ukhra-bâzâush
nivânât parô tbishyañbyô.
segments.en:
'May we keep our field; may we never be 
exiles from our field, exiles from our house, exiles 
from our borough, exiles from our town, exiles from 
our country.
segments.zh: 願我們保護我們的田野；願我們永遠不流亡於我們的田野之外，不流亡於我們的家之外，不流亡於我們的街鎮之外，不流亡於我們的城鎮之外，不流亡於我們的國度之外。

segments.orig:
tûm aêshãm tbishyatãm tûm
aêshãm tbaêshanguhatãm tbaêshå
sciñdayehi,
sciñdaya ashavajanô
hvaspô ahi hurâthyô
zavanô-sva ahi sûrô.
segments.en:
'Thou dashest in pieces the malice of the 
malicious, the malice of the men of malice: dash 
thou in pieces the killers of faithful men!
'Thou hast good horses, thou hast a good 
chariot: thou art bringing help at every appeal, and 
art powerful.
segments.zh:
你粉碎惡意者的惡意，惡意之人的惡意：你也粉碎害死信忠之人的殺手吧！
你有良好的馬匹，你有良好的戰車：你在每次呼籲時都帶來幫助，而且強大。

segments.orig:
âca-thwâ zbayâi avainghe,
âca-nô jamyât avainghe
ash-frâyashtica zaothranãm hufrâyashtica ash-frabereitica
zaothranãm hufrabereitica ýatha thwâ aiwishayamna
darekha aiwishayana
hushitem berekhmya-shaêtem.
segments.en:
'I will pray unto thee for help, with many 
consecrations, with good consecrations of libations; 
with many offerings, with good offerings of libations, 
that we, abiding in thee, may long inhabit a good 
abode, full of all the riches that can be wished for.
segments.zh: 我將以眾多的奉獻、良好的灑奠奉獻、眾多的祭品、良好的灑奠祭品向你祈禱求助，願我們住在你之中，長久居住在美好的住所，充滿所有可被期盼的財富。

segments.orig:
tûm tâ dainghâvô nipâhi
ýâ hubereitîm ýâtayeiti
mithrahe vouru-gaoyaoitish,
tûm tâ frasciñdayehi
ýâ rãxshyeitîsh dainghâvô,
âca-thwâ zbayâi avainghe,
âca-nô jamyât avah'yâi
ukhrô aiwithûrô ýesnyô vahmyô
mithrô raêvå dainghupaitish.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'Thou keepest those nations that tender a 
good worship to Mithra, the lord of wide pastures; 
thou dashest in pieces those that delight in havoc. 
Unto thee will I pray for help: may he come to us 
for help, the awful, most powerful Mithra, the 
worshipful and praiseworthy, the glorious lord of 
nations.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
「你保護那些向廣牧之主密特拉獻上美好祭祀的民族；你粉碎那些喜好掠奪的民族。我將向你祈禱求助。願那可畏的、最強大的密特拉、可敬拜的、應讚美的、光榮的民族之主來臨為我們助力。
『為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻給他配得聽聞的祭祀……』」

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem
ýô rashnush daidhe maêthanem
ýahmâi rashnush darekhâi haxedhrâi
frabavara manavaiñtîm.
segments.zh:
「我們祭祀廣牧之主密特拉，……不眠者，永遠守醒者；
『他為拉什努造就了住所，拉什努將他的全部心靈獻與他以換取長久的友誼；』」

segments.orig:
tûm maêthanahe pâta
nipâta ahi adruzhãm,
tûm varezânahe paiti
nish-hareta ahi adruzhãm,
thwâ paiti zî haxedhrem daidhe vahishtem
verethrakhnemca ahuradhâtem
ýahmi sôire mithrô-drujô
aipi vîthishi jata
paurva mashyâkånghô.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'Thou art a keeper and protector of the dwelling 
of those who lie not: thou art the maintainer of 
those who lie not. With thee hath Verethraghna, 
made by Ahura, contracted the best of all friendships, 
and thus it is how so many men who have 
lied unto Mithra, even privily, lie smitten down on 
the ground.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
「你是不說謊者住所的守護者與保護者；你是不說謊者的維持者。與你結成最佳友誼的是由阿胡拉所造的韋雷特拉格納，因此許多向密特拉說謊、甚至私下說謊的人就這樣被打倒在地。
『為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻給他配得聽聞的祭祀……』」

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem
ýô rashnush daidhe maêthanem
ýahmâi rashnush darekhâi haxedhrâi
bavara manavaiñtîm.
segments.zh:
「我們祭祀廣牧之主密特拉，……不眠者，永遠守醒者；
『他為拉什努造就了住所，拉什努將他的全部心靈獻與他以換取長久的友誼；』」

segments.orig:
ýenghe hazangrem ýaoxshtinãm
fradathat ahurô mazdå
baêvare dôithranãm vîdôithre, âat
âbyô dôithrâbyô aiwyasca ýaoxshtibyô
spasyeiti mithrô-zyãm mithrô-drujemca, âat
âbyô dôithrâbyô aiwyasca ýaoxshtibyô
adhaoyô asti mithrô ýô baêvare-spasanô
sûrô vîspô- vîdhvå adhaoyamnô.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'To whom Ahura Mazda gave a thousand 
 
senses and ten thousand eyes to see. With those 
eyes and those senses, he watches the man who 
injures Mithra, the man who lies unto Mithra. 
Through those eyes and those senses, he is undeceivable, 
he, of the ten thousand spies, the powerful, 
all-knowing, undeceivable god.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
「阿胡拉‧馬茲達給了他一千種感知與一萬隻眼睛以看見。他用那些眼睛與那些感知監視傷害密特拉的人、向密特拉說謊的人。通過那些眼睛與那些感知，他無可欺瞞，他這位擁有一萬個間諜的、強大的、全知的、無可欺瞞的神。
『為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻給他配得聽聞的祭祀……』」

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem ýim
dainghêush dainghupaitish bâdha ustânazastô
zbayeiti avainghe, ýim zañtêush zañtupaitish
bâdha ustânazastô zbayeiti avainghe.
segments.zh:
「我們祭祀廣牧之主密特拉，……不眠者，永遠守醒者；
『國家之主舉起雙手向他祈禱求助；
『城鎮之主舉起雙手向他祈禱求助；』」

segments.orig:
ýim vîsô vîspaitish bâdha ustânazastô
zbayeiti avainghe, ýim nmânahe nmânô-paitish
bâdha ustânazastô zbayeiti avainghe, ýim
dvâcina pithe hacimna bâdha ustânazastô
zbayeiti avainghe,
ýim drikhushcit ashôtkaêshô
apayatô havâish dâtâish bâdha ustânazastô
zbayeiti avainghe,
segments.zh:
「鄉村之主舉起雙手向他祈禱求助；
『家庭之主舉起雙手向他祈禱求助；
『……陷於死亡危險的人舉起雙手向他祈禱求助；
『遵循美好律法的貧苦人，當他遭受不公正對待與被剝奪權利時，舉起雙手向他祈禱求助。」

segments.orig:
ýenghe vâxsh gerezânahe
us ava raocå ashnaoiti
ava pairi imãm zãm jasaiti
vî hapta karshvãn jasaiti ýatcit nemangha
vâcim baraiti ýat gaoshcit.
segments.en:
'The voice of his wailing reaches up to the 
sky, it goes over the earth all around, it goes over 
 
the seven karshwars, whether he utters his prayer 
in a low tone of voice or aloud.
segments.zh: 「他哭喊的聲音直達天空，它環繞整個大地傳播，它傳遍七個卡爾什瓦爾，無論他以低沉的聲音還是大聲誦唸他的祈禱詞。」

segments.orig:
ýâ vareta azimna
badhâ ustânazastô zbayeiti avainghe
gavaithîm paitishmaremna,
kadha-nô arsha gavaithîm
apayât paskât vazemnô
mithrô ýô vouru-gaoyaoitish
kadha-nô fraourvaêsayâiti
ashahe paiti pañtãm
drujô vaêsmenda azemnãm.
segments.en:
'The cow driven astray invokes him for help, 
longing for the stables:
'"When will that bull, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
bring us back, and make us reach the 
stables? when will he turn us back to the right 
way from the den of the Druj where we were
driven?"
segments.zh: 被趕散的母牛呼喚他求助，渴望回到牲畜棚：『那頭公牛，密特拉啊，寬牧場的主人啊，何時才會把我們帶回去，讓我們回到牲畜棚？何時才會把我們從德魯格的巢穴中轉向正道，我們被趕到那個地方去？』

segments.orig:
âat ýahmâi xshnûtô bavaiti
mithrô ýô vouru-gaoyaoitish
ahmâi jasaiti avainghe,
âat ýahmâi tbishtô bavaiti
mithrô ýô vouru-gaoyaoitish ahmâi frasciñdayeiti
nmânemca vîsemca zañtûmca dah'yûmca
dainghusastîmca.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'And to him with whom Mithra, the lord of 
wide pastures, has been satisfied, he comes with 
help; and of him with whom Mithra, the lord of 
wide pastures, has been offended, he crushes down 
the house, the borough, the town, the province, the 
country.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh: 密特拉，寬牧場的主人，對他滿意的人，他就帶著幫助而來；對他不滿意的人，密特拉，寬牧場的主人，就摧毀他的房屋、城鎮、都邑、省份、國家。為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將向他獻上一場值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem ýim
ýazata
haomô frâshmish baêshazyô
srîrô xshathryô zairidôithrô
barezishte paiti barezahi
haraithyô paiti barezayå
ýat vaocê hûkairîm nãma
anâhitem anâhitô
anâhitât parô baresmen anâhitayât
parô zaothrayât anâhitaêibyô parô
vakhzhibyô.
segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'To whom the enlivening, healing, fair, lordly, 
golden-eyed Haoma offered up a sacrifice on the 
highest of the heights, on the Haraiti Bareza, he 
 
the undefiled to one undefiled, with undefiled 
baresma, undefiled libations, and undefiled words;
segments.zh: 我們向密特拉獻祭，寬牧場的主人……不眠者，永遠醒著者。賜予生命、療癒、美麗、威嚴、金眼的豪麻在最高的高地上，在哈拉赫瓦提‧巴雷紮山上，向他獻上了祭祀——他這個未被玷污者向未被玷污者獻祭，用未被玷污的聖木、未被玷污的奠酒、未被玷污的聖言。

segments.orig:
ýim zaotârem stayata
ahurô mazdå ashava
âsu-ýasnem berezi-gâthrem, ýazata zaota
âsu-ýasnô berezi-gâthrô berezata
vaca zaota ahurâi mazdâi zaota ameshanãm speñtanãm,
hô vâxsh us ava raocå ashnaot ava pairi imãm
zãm jasat vîjasât vîspâish avi
karshvãn ýâish hapta.
segments.en:
'Whom the holy Ahura Mazda has established 
as a priest, quick in performing the sacrifice 
and loud in song. He performed the sacrifice with 
a loud voice, as a priest quick in sacrifice and loud 
in song, a priest to Ahura Mazda, a priest to 
the Amesha-Spentas. His voice reached up to the 
sky, went over the earth all around, went over the 
seven keshwars.
segments.zh: 聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達任命了他為祭司，迅速進行祭祀，高聲唱頌。他以高聲進行了祭祀，如同一位迅速進行祭祀、高聲唱頌的祭司，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的祭司，大天神的祭司。他的聲音上達天空，環繞大地而去，越過七個地域。

segments.orig:
ýô paoiryô hâvana haomã uzdasta
stehrpaêsangha mainyutâshta
haraithyô paiti barezayå,
berejayat ahurô mazdå
berejayen ameshå speñta
ýenghå kehrpô huraodhayå
ýahmâi hvare aurvat-aspem
dûrât nemô baodhayeiti,
segments.en:
'Who first lifted up Haomas, in a mortar 
inlaid with stars and made of a heavenly substance. 
Ahura Mazda longed for him, the Amesha-Spentas 
longed for him, for the well-slapen body of him 
whom the swift-horsed sun awakes for prayer from 
afar.
segments.zh: 他首先用繁星鑲嵌、天界物質製成的研缽舉起了豪麻。阿胡拉‧馬茲達渴望他，大天神渴望他，渴望那具體態優美的身軀——迅馬駕日者從遠方喚他起來進行禱告。

segments.orig:
nemô mithrâi vouru-gaoyaoitêe hazangrô-
gaoshâi baêvare-cashmaine,
ýesnyô ahi vahmyô
ýesnyô buyå vahmyô
nmânâhu mashyâkanãm,
ushta buyât ahmâi naire
ýase-thwâ bâdha frâyazâite

frasteretât paiti baresmen uzdâtât paiti haomât
srâvayamnât paiti ahunât vairyât.
segments.en:
'Hail to Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, who 
has a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes! Thou 
art worthy of sacrifice and prayer: mayest thou have 
sacrifice and prayer in the houses of men! Hail to 
the man who shall offer thee a sacrifice, with the 
holy wood in his hand, the baresma in his hand, 
the holy meat in his hand, the holy mortar in his 
hand, with his hands well-washed, with the mortar 
well-washed, with the bundles of baresma tied up, 
the Haoma uplifted, and the Ahuna Vairya sung 
through.
segments.zh:
'願歡呼給密特拉，廣闊牧場之主，誰
擁有一千隻耳朵和一萬隻眼睛！ 你
你是值得祭祀和祈禱： 願你擁有
祭祀和祈禱在人們的房屋裡！ 願歡呼給
那個人將會向你獻上祭祀， 與
聖木在他手， 巴雷斯瑪在他手，
聖肉在他手中，聖臼在他
手，雙手洗淨，與臼
洗淨，與繫好的巴爾斯瑪束,
豪麻被舉起，以及阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞被唱
透過。

segments.orig:
aya daênaya fraoreñta
ahurô mazdå ashava frâ vohu manô frâ

ârmaiti frâ haurvata ameretâta,

ýôi-thwâ vaênen dâmôhu

vahishtãm.
segments.en:
'The holy Ahura Mazda confessed that religion 
and so did Vohu-Mano, so did Asha-Vahishta, 
so did Khshathra-Vairya, so did Spenta-Armaiti, so 
 
did Haurvatat and Ameretat; and all the Amesha-Spentas 
longed for and confessed his religion. The 
kind Mazda conferred upon him the mastership 
of the world; and [so did they] who saw thee
amongst all creatures the right lord and master of 
the world, the best cleanser of these creatures.
segments.zh: 聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達認可了這個信仰，沃胡‧馬納也認可了，阿沙‧瓦希什塔也認可了，赫沙特拉‧瓦伊里亞也認可了，斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提也認可了，胡爾瓦塔特與阿梅雷塔特也認可了；所有大天神都渴望並認可了他的信仰。和藹的馬茲達賦予他世界的主權；他們也見證了你在所有生物中是世界的真正主人與統治者，這些生物最好的淨化者。

segments.orig:
adha vaêibya ahubya
vaêibya nô ahubya nipayå
âi mithra vouru-gaoyaoite
aheca anghêush ýô astvatô
ýasca asti manahyô pairi drvatat mahrkât pairi
drvatat aêshmât
pairi drvataêibyô haênêbyô
ýå us xrûrem drafshem gerewnãn
aêshmahe parô draomêbyô
ýå aêshmô duzhdå drâvayât
mat vîdhâtaot daêvô-dâtât.
segments.en:
'So mayest thou in both worlds, mayest thou 
keep us in both worlds, O Mithra, lord of wide pastures! 
both in this material world and in the world of 
the spirit, from the fiend of Death, from the fiend 
Aeshma, from the fiendish hordes, that lift up the 
spear of havoc, and from the onsets of Aeshma, 
wherein the evil-doing Aeshma rushes along with 
Vidotu, made by the Daevas.
segments.zh: 願你在兩個世界，願你在兩個世界保護我們，密特拉啊，寬牧場的主人啊！無論在這個物質世界還是靈界，保護我們免受死亡的惡魔、埃什瑪的惡魔、邪惡的群魔——那些舉起混亂之矛者——以及埃什瑪的來襲，其中邪惡作為的埃什瑪與維多圖一同奔馳，那是達埃瓦製造的。

segments.orig:
adha-nô-tûm mithra vouru-gaoyaoite
zâvare dayå hitaêibyô
drvatâtem tanubyô
pouru-spaxshtîm tbishyañtãm
paiti-jaitîm dushmainyunãm
hathrânivâitîm hamerethanãm
aurvathanãm tbishyañtãm.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'So mayest thou, O Mithra, lord of wide pastures! 
give swiftness to our teams, strength to our 
own bodies, and that we may watch with full success 
those who hate us, smite down our foes, and 
destroy at one stroke our adversaries, our enemies 
and those who hate us.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth 
being heard....
segments.zh: 願你，密特拉啊，寬牧場的主人啊！給我們的馬隊以迅速，給我們的身體以力量，讓我們能成功地監視那些仇恨我們的人，擊倒我們的敵人，一舉摧毀我們的對手、敵手與那些仇恨我們的人。為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將向他獻上一場值得聆聽的祭祀……

segments.orig:

ainghå zemô ýat pathanayå

after the setting of the sun, touches both ends of 
 
this wide, round earth, whose ends lie afar, and 
surveys everything that is between the earth and 
the heavens,
segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣牧之主……
睡眠不至，永恆清醒；
他遍歷大地，其全部寬度，
日沒之後，
觸及這廣闊、圓形大地的兩端，
其兩端遠在彼處，
調查介於大地與諸天之間的一切。

segments.orig:
vazrem zastaya drazhemnô

segments.en:
'Swinging in his hands a club with a hundred 
knots, a hundred edges, that rushes forwards and 
fells men down; a club cast out of red brass, of 
strong, golden brass; the strongest of all weapons, 
the most victorious of all weapons;
segments.zh:
手中揮舞著一根百結、百刃的棍棒，
向前衝去，擊落男子；
一根由紅銅鑄出的棍棒，
堅固的金銅；
所有武器中最強者，
所有武器中最勝利者；

segments.orig:
ýahmat haca frateresaiti
angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
ýahmat haca frateresaiti

segments.en:
'From whom Angra Mainyu, who is all death, 
flees away in fear; from whom Aeshma, the evil-doing 
Peshotanu, flees away in fear; from whom 
the long-handed Bushyasta flees away in fear; 
from whom all the Daevas unseen and the Varenya 
fiends flee away in fear.
segments.zh:
安格拉‧曼紐，全然死亡者，
因他而恐懼逃離；
埃什瑪，行惡者佩紹坦努，
因他而恐懼逃離；
長臂布什亞斯塔，
因他而恐懼逃離；
所有未見之達埃瓦與瓦雷納魔鬼
皆因他而恐懼逃離。

segments.orig:
mâ mithrahe vouru-gaoyaoitôish
grañtahe vaêkhâi jasaêma,
mâ-nô grañtô aipi-janyå
mithra ýô vouru-gaoyaoitish
ýô aojishtô ýazatanãm
ýô tañcishtô ýazatanãm
ýô thwaxshishtô ýazatanãm
ýô âsishtô ýazatanãm

fraxshtaite paiti âya zemâ

segments.en:
'Oh! may we never fall across the rush of 
Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, when in anger! 
May Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, never smite 
us in his anger; he who stands up upon this earth 
as the strongest of all gods, the most valiant of all 
gods, the most energetic of all gods, the swiftest of 
all gods, the most fiend-smiting of all gods, he, 
Mithra, the lord of wide pastures.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
噢！願我等永不遇上
密特拉、廣牧之主在怒火中的衝擊！
願密特拉、廣牧之主永不在怒中擊我等；
他站立於此大地之上，
為諸神中最強者，
諸神中最英勇者，
諸神中最精力充沛者，
諸神中最迅捷者，
諸神中最摧魔者，
他，密特拉，廣牧之主。
為其光輝與榮耀，我將獻給他一場值得被聽聞的祭禮……

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'From whom all the Daevas unseen and the 
Varenya fiends flee away in fear.
 
'The lord of nations, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, 
drives forward at the right-hand side of 
this wide, round earth, whose ends lie afar.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣牧之主……
睡眠不至，永恆清醒；
所有未見之達埃瓦與瓦雷納魔鬼
皆因他而恐懼逃離。
邦國之主，密特拉，廣牧之主，
在此廣闊、圓形大地之右側驅車前行，
其兩端遠在彼處。

segments.orig:
dashinem hê upa aredhem vazaite ýô vanghush

ýåsca urvarå ýåsca ashaonãm

segments.en:
'At his right hand drives the good, holy 
Sraosha; at his left hand drives the tall and strong 
Rashnu; on all sides around him drive the waters, 
the plants, and the Fravashis of the faithful.
segments.zh:
在他的右手，善良、聖潔的斯魯沙驅車前行；
在他的左手，高大、強壯的拉什努驅車前行；
在他周圍四方，眾水、眾植物與信信者的弗拉瓦希
皆驅車前行。

segments.orig:
avi-dîsh aêm xshayamnô hamatha baraiti ishavô
erezifyô-parena, âat ýat athra para-jasaiti
vazemnô ýathra dainghâvô avi-mithranyå
hô paoiryô gadhãm nijaiñti
aspaêca paiti vîraêca,
hathra tarshta thrånghayete
vaya aspa-vîraja.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'In his might, he ever brings to them falcon-feathered 
arrows, and, when diiving, he himself 
comes there, where are nations, enemy to Mithra, 
he, first and foremost, strikes blows with his club 
on the horse and his rider; he throws fear and 
fright upon the horse and his rider.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
憑其力量，他常為他們帶來隼羽之箭，
且當駕駛時，他本身來臨於此處，
於敵對密特拉的邦國之地，
他最先最前，以其棍棒擊馬與騎者；
他將恐懼與驚懼投向馬與騎者。
為其光輝與榮耀，我將獻給他一場值得被聽聞的祭禮……

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem aurushâspem
tizhi-arshtîm darekha-areshtaêm
xshviwi-ishûm parô-kevîdhem
hunairyåñcim rathaêshtãm.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀密特拉，廣牧之主……
睡眠不至，永恆清醒；
白馬之戰士，銳矛持者，長矛持者，迅箭射者；
遠見者且聰慧者；

segments.orig:
ýim haretâremca aiwyâxshtâremca
fradathat ahurô mazdå
vîspayå fravôish gaêthayå,

vîspayå fravôish gaêthayå,

segments.en:
'Whom Ahura Mazda has established to 
maintain and look over all this moving world, and 
who maintains and looks over all this moving world; 
who, never sleeping, wakefully guards the creation 
of Mazda; who, never sleeping, wakefully maintains 
the creation of Mazda;
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達所建立、以維持並監督這一切活動的世界、且維持並監督這一切活動的世界者；永不睡眠、警覺地守護馬茲達的造物；永不睡眠、警覺地維持馬茲達的造物者。
為了他的光輝和榮光，我將獻祭予他，值得被聽聞的祭禮……

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem
ýenghe darekhâcit bâzava
fragreweñti mithrô-aojanghô
ýatcit ushastaire hiñdvô âgeurvayeite
ýatcit daoshataire nikhne
ýatcit sanake ranghayå
ýatcit vîmaidhîm ainghå zemô.
segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'Whose long arms, strong with Mithra-strength, encompass what
he seizes in the easternmost river and what he beats with the
westernmost river, what is by the Sanaka of the Rangha and what
is by the boundary of the earth.
segments.zh:
我們獻祭予密特拉，廣牧地之主……永不睡眠，永遠清醒者。
密特拉以其長臂、以密特拉之力的強健，環抱他在最東方河流所奪取之物，和他用最西方河流所擊打之物，桑納卡河（蘭哈河）所在之處和大地邊界所在之處。

segments.orig:
temcit mithrô hañgrefshemnô
pairi apaya bâzuwe,
dushhvarenå nashtô razishta
ashâtô asti anguhaya,
itha mainyete dushhvarenå,
nôit imat vîspem duzhvarshtem
nôit vîspem aiwi-druxtêe
mithrô vaênaiti apishma.
segments.en:
'And thou, O Mithra! encompassing all this around, do thou
reach it, all over, with thy arms.
'The man without glory, led astray from the right way, grieves
in his heart; the man without glory thinks thus in himself: "That
careless Mithra does not see all the evil that is done, nor all
the lies that are told."
segments.zh:
你啊，密特拉！環抱這一切周圍，你要用你的臂膀遍及其全部。
無榮光之人、被引離正道者，他的心中憂傷；無榮光之人如此在自己心中想：「那粗心的密特拉看不見所有所做之惡，也看不見所有所言之謊。」

segments.en:
'"Should the heavenly wisdom in the earthly man be a
hundred times greater, it would not rise so high as the heavenly
w'isdom in the heavenly Mithra;
''And thus, should the ears of the earthly man hear a hundred
time better, he would not hear so well as the heavenly Mithra,
whose ear hears well who has a thousand senses, and sees every
man that tells a lie."
'Mithra stands up in his strength, he drives in the awfulness
of royalty, and sends from his eyes beautiful looks that shine
from afar, (saying):
segments.zh:
"應該天上的智慧在凡人中是一
一百倍更大，它不會升得那麼高，如同天上的
w'isdom在天上的密特拉；
''因此，應該凡人的耳朵聽見一百
'時間更好，他將不會聽得那麼好，如同上天的密特拉，
'誰的耳朵聽得好，誰有一千種感官，並看見每一
說謊的人。"
'密特拉在他力量中站起來，他駕駛在可怕中
皇家的，並從他的眼睛發出美麗的目光閃耀
從遠方, (說):

segments.orig:
kô mãm ýazâite kô druzhât
kô huyeshti kô duzhyeshti
mãm zî mainyete ýazatem,
kahmâi raêshca hvarenasca
kahmâi tanvô drvatâtem
azem baxshâni xshayamnô,
kahmâi îshtîm pourush-hvâthrãm
azem baxshâni xshayamnô
kahmâi âsnãmcit frazaiñtîm
us apara barezayeni,
segments.en:
''Who will offer me a sacrifice? Who will lie unto me? Who
thinks me a god worthy of a good sacrifice? Who thinks me worthy
only of a bad sacrifice? To whom shall I, in my might, impart
brightness and glory? To whom bodily health? To whom shall I,
in my might, impart riches and full weal? Whom shall I bless by
raising him a virtuous offspring?
segments.zh: 「誰將獻祭於我？誰將對我說謊？誰認為我是值得好祭禮的亞扎塔？誰認為我只值得壞祭禮？我以我的力量，要將光輝和榮光賦予誰？要將肉身的健康賦予誰？我以我的力量，要將財富和完善的福祉賦予誰？我要以生育品德的後代而祝福誰？

segments.orig:
kahmâi azem ukhrem xshathrem
hvainisaxtem pouru-spâdhem
amainimnahe mananghô
paiti-dathâni vahishtem
sâthrascit hamô-xshathrahe
kameredhô-janô aurvahe
vanatô avanemnahe
ýô nishtayeiti keretêe sraoshyãm, ishare
hâ nishtâta kiryeiti
ýezi grañtô nishtayeiti
tbishtahecit axshnushtahe
mithra manô râmayeiti
huxshnûitîm paiti mithrahe.
segments.en:
"'To whom shall I give in return, without his thinking
of it, the awful sovereignty, beautifully. arrayed, with many
armies, and most perfect; the sovereignty of an all-powerful tyrant,
who fells down heads, valiant, smiting, and unsmitten; who orders
chastisement to be done and his order is done at once, which he
has ordered in his anger?"
'O Mithra! when thou art offended and not satisfied, he soothes
thy mind, and makes Mithra satisfied.
segments.zh:
「我要無他所想地給予誰，那可怕的主權、妝點得華美、帶著眾多軍隊、且最完善；全能暴君的主權，摧伏眾頭、勇敢、擊打、未被擊打者；他命令懲罰被行使，他的命令立即被執行，他在怒火中所命令之事？」
密特拉啊！當你被冒犯而不滿足時，他安撫你的心智，使密特拉得到滿足。

segments.orig:

'"To whom shall I, in my might, impart sickness and death?
To whom shall I impart poverty and sterility? Of whom shall I
at one stroke cut off the offspring!
segments.zh: 「我以我的力量，要將疾病和死亡賦予誰？我要將貧窮和不孕賦予誰？我要一舉斷絕誰的後代！

segments.orig:

hvainisaxtem pouru-spâdhem
amainimnahe mananghô
apabarâni vahishtem

segments.en:
'"From whom shall I take away, without his thinking of
it, the awful sovereignty, beautifully arrayed, with many armies,
and most perfect; the sovereignty of an all-powerful tyrant, who
fells down heads, valiant, smiting, and unsmitten; who orders
chastisement to be done and his order is done at once, which he
has ordered in his anger."
'O Mithra! while thou art satisfied and not angry, he moves thy
heart to anger, and makes Mithra unsatisfied.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
我應該從誰那裡奪走，而他不會思考的
它，可怕的主權，華麗地陳列，擁有許多軍隊，
而且最完美；全能暴君的主權，誰
砍下頭顱，勇猛，擊打，且未被擊打；誰下令
施加懲罰，且他的命令立即執行，這他
他在怒火中所下達的命令。
'O 密特拉！ 當你是滿足且不生氣， 他移動你的
心向怒，以及使密特拉不滿意。
'因為他的亮度以及榮耀，我將提供他一個祭品價值
存在被聽見....

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....
sleepless, and ever awake;
'A warrior with a silver helm, a golden cuirass, who kills with
the poniard, strong, valiant, lord of the borough. Bright are
the ways of Mithra, by which he goes towards the country, when,
wishing well, he turns its plains and vales to pasture grounds,
segments.zh:
我們獻祭予密特拉，廣牧地之主……永不睡眠，永遠清醒者。
一位頭盔為銀色、胸甲為金色的戰士，以短劍殺人者，強壯、勇敢、城鎮之主。密特拉的道路是光明的，他沿著它走向國家，當他懷著善意時，他把那平原和山谷轉變成放牧地。

segments.orig:
tadha nô jamyât avainghe
mithra ahura berezañta
ýat berezem barât ashtra vâcim

segments.en:
'And then cattle and males come to graze, as many as he wants.
'May Mithra and Ahura, the high gods, come to us for help, when
the poniard lifts up its voice aloud, when the nostrils of the
horses quiver, when the poniards ...., when the, strings of the
bows whistle and shoot sharp arrows; then the brood of those whose
libations are hated fall smitten to the ground, with their hair
torn off.
segments.zh:
那時牲畜和公獸前來放牧，盡他所欲。
願密特拉和阿胡拉，至高的神祇，在短劍高聲鳴叫之時，在馬匹鼻孔顫動之時，在短劍……之時，在弓弦呼嘯與射出尖銳箭矢之時，前來幫助我們。那時仇恨的奠祭者的子孫墮落在地，被擊殺，頭髮被撕裂。

segments.orig:
adha-nô-tûm mithra vouru-gaoyaoite
zâvare dayå hitaêibyô
drvatâtem tanubyô
pouru-spaxshtîm tbishyañtãm
paiti-jaitîm dushmainyunãm
hathrânivâitîm hamerethanãm

ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
'So mayest thou, O Mithra, lord of wide pastures! give swiftness
to our teams, strength to our own bodies, and that we may watch
with full success those who hate us, smite down our foes, and
destroy at one stroke our adversaries, our enemies, and those
who hate us.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
願你如此，寬闊草場之主密特拉啊！賜予我們的隊伍以迅速，賜予我們身體以力量，願我們能夠完滿地監察那些憎恨我們的人，擊倒我們的敵人，並一舉摧毀我們的對手、我們的敵人，以及那些憎恨我們的人。
為了他的光輝和榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聽聞的祭祀……

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, ....

'O Mithra, lord of wide pastures! thou master of the house, of
the borough, of the town, of the country, thou Zarathushtrotema!
segments.zh:
我們向寬闊草場之主密特拉獻祭，……不眠者，永遠警醒者。
寬闊草場之主密特拉啊！你是家庭的主人、村落的主人、城鎮的主人、國家的主人，你查拉圖斯特拉之主啊！

密特拉在兩位合夥人之間具有四十倍的力量。
密特拉在妻子和丈夫之間具有五十倍的力量。
密特拉在兩位弟子（同一師父的）之間具有六十倍的力量。
密特拉在弟子和他的師父之間具有七十倍的力量。
密特拉在女婿和他的岳父之間具有八十倍的力量。
密特拉在兩位兄弟之間具有九十倍的力量。

密特拉在父親和兒子之間具有百倍的力量。

密特拉與馬茲達的律法相連時具有萬倍的力量，這樣他將每日具有勝利的力量。

segments.en:
'May I come unto thee with a prayer that goes lowly or goes
highly! As this sun rises up above the Hara Berezaiti and then
fulfils its career, so may I, O Spitama! with a prayer that goes
lowly or goes highly, rise up above the will of the fiend Angra
Mainyu!
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
願我以低伏的或高舉的禱詞來到你面前！正如這太陽升起於哈拉‧貝雷扎伊提之上，然後完成其歷程，願我，斯皮塔瑪啊！以低伏的或高舉的禱詞升起於惡靈安格拉‧曼紐的意志之上！
為了他的光輝和榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聽聞的祭祀……

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'We sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastwes, ....
sleepless, and ever awake,
'Offer up a sacrifice unto Mithra, O Spitama! and order thy pupils
to do the same.
'Let the worshipper of Mazda sacrifice unto thee with small cattle,
with black cattle, with flying birds, gliding forward on wings.
segments.zh:
我們向寬闊草場之主密特拉獻祭，……不眠者，永遠警醒者。
斯皮塔瑪啊，向密特拉獻祭，並命令你的弟子也做同樣的事。
願馬茲達的信奉者用小牲畜、黑色牲畜、飛翔的鳥類向你獻祭，這些鳥類在翅膀上前行滑翔。

segments.en:
'To Mithra all the faithful worshiypers of Mazda must give
strength and energy with offered and proffered Haomas, which the
Zaotar proffers unto him and gives in sacrifice. Let the faithful
man drink of the libations cleanly prepared, which if he does,
if he offers them unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, Mithra
will be pleased with him and without anger.'
segments.zh: 密特拉必須得到所有信心堅定的馬茲達信奉者以獻上和呈上的豪麻賜予力量和精力，祭司向他呈上並獻上豪麻。願信心堅定的人飲用潔淨製備的奠祭，若他這樣做，若他向寬闊草場之主密特拉獻上它們，密特拉將對他感到滿意且不懷怨怒。

segments.orig:
paiti-dim peresat zarathushtrô, kutha ahura mazda nâ
ashava ýaozhdâtãm zaothrãm franguharât
ýô kerenavât ýim ýazaite mithrem
ýim vouru-gaoyaoitîm xshnûtô atbishtô

segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked him: 'O Ahura Mazda! how shall the faithful
man drink the libations cleanly prepared, which if he does and
he offers them unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, Mithra
will be pleased vvith him and without anger?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問他：「持阿沙的聖者啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！忠信之人應當如何飲用潔淨備妥的奠酒呢？若他如此行，並將之獻予寬廣牧場之主密特拉，密特拉會對他滿悅而無怒意呢？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thri-ayarem thri-xshaparem
tanûm frasnayayañta thrisatem upâzananãm
pairi-âkayayañta mithrahe vouru-gaoyaoitôish
ýasnâica vahmâica, bi-ayarem bi-xshaparem tanûm

âmâtô vîspe ratavô.

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Let them wash their bodies three days
and three nights; let them undergo thirty strokes for the sacrifice
and prayer unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures. Let them wash
their bodies two days and two nights; let them undergo twenty
strokes for the sacrifice and prayer unto Mithra, the lord of
wide pastures. Let no man drink of these libations who does not
know the staota yesnya: Vispe ratavo.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacriace worth
being heard....
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「令他們洗淨身體三日三夜；令他們為獻祭及對寬廣牧場之主密特拉的禱祝承受三十鞭。令他們洗淨身體二日二夜；令他們為獻祭及對寬廣牧場之主密特拉的禱祝承受二十鞭。任何不知曉斯塔歐塔‧耶斯尼亞者不得飲此奠酒：維斯佩‧拉塔沃。『為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻他一宗應被聽聞的祭祀⋯⋯』」

segments.orig:
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm ... jakhaurvånghem,
ýim ýazata ahurô mazdå
raoxshnât paiti garô-nmânât.
segments.zh: 『我們獻祭予寬廣牧場之主密特拉，⋯⋯不眠者，恆久守醒者；『阿胡拉‧馬茲達曾在閃耀的加羅‧納瑪納向他獻祭。』」

segments.orig:
uzbâzâush paiti amerextîm
fravazaite mithrô ýô vouru-gaoyaoitish
haca raoxshnât garô-nmânât
vâshem srîrem vavazânem hâmô-taxmem

segments.en:
'With his arms lifted up towards Immortality, Mithra, the
lord of wide pastures, drives forward from the shining Garo-nmana,
in a beautiful chariot that drives on, ever-swift, adorned with
all sorts of ornaments, and made of gold.
segments.zh: 『密特拉，寬廣牧場之主，舉起雙臂指向不朽聖者，從閃耀的加羅‧納瑪納駕馭前行，乘坐於一輛美麗的戰車，行進迅速，恆久飛馳，飾以各樣華飾，全金打造。』」

segments.orig:
ahmya vâshe vazåñte
cathwârô aurvañtô
spaêtita hama-gaonånghô

ivãmca simãmca simôithrãmca dereta

segments.en:
'Four stallions draw that chariot, all of the same white colour,
living on heavenly food and undying. The hoofs of their fore-feet
are shod with gold, the hoofs of their hind-feet are shod with
silver; all are yoked to the same pole, and wear the yoke and
the cross-beams of the yoke, fastened with hooks of Khshathra
vairya to a beautiful....
segments.zh: 『四匹公馬駕馭此戰車，色澤白淨相同，食天界之食不知衰亡。其前蹄釘以黃金，其後蹄釘以白銀；全部軛於同一轛木，著軛繫及軛橫樑，以赫沙特拉‧瓦伊里亞之勾連結於美麗的⋯⋯』」

segments.orig:
dashinem hê aredhe vazaite rashnvô razishtô

segments.en:
'At his right hand drives Rashnu-Razishta, the most beneficent
and most well-shapen.
'At his left hand drives the most upright Chista, the holy one,
bearing libations in her hands, clothed with white clothes, and
white herself; and the cursing thought of the Law of Mazda.
segments.zh: 『拉什努‧拉奇什塔最慈善、最善形者駕於他的右手邊。『最正直的聖者奇斯塔駕於他的左手邊，手持奠酒，著白衣裳，自身亦白；及馬茲達之法的詛咒思想。』」

segments.orig:
upavazata taxmô dâmôish upamanô
hû kehrpa varâzahe
paiti-erenô tizhi-dãstrahe
arshnô tizhi-asûrahe
hakeret-janô varâzahe
anu-pôithwahe grañtahe
parshvanikahe taxmahe
ýûxdhahe pâirivâzahe, nixshata ahmât

segments.en:
'Close by him drives the strong cursing thought of the wise
man, opposing foes in the shape of a boar, a sharp-toothed he-boar,
a sharp- jawed boar, that kills at one stroke, pursuing, wrathful,
with a dripping face, strong and swift to run, and rushing all
around.
'Behind him drives Atar, all in a blaze, and the awful kingly
Glory.
segments.zh: 『智者的強大詛咒思想駕於他近側，對抗敵者呈野豬形狀，尖牙公野豬，尖頜野豬，一擊致命者，追逐、忿怒、流涎面容、強健、馳驟迅速、衝撞四方。『阿塔爾駕於他身後，火焰燃燒，及可怖的王者榮耀。』」

segments.orig:

stand a thousand bows well-made, with a string of cowgut; they
go through the heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly
space upon the skulls of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 『在寬廣牧場之主密特拉的戰車一側，放置千張善制之弓，弦為牛腸；它們穿過天界空間，它們落下穿過天界空間打向達埃瓦的顱骨。』」

segments.orig:

mainyavaså vazeñti
mainyavaså pateñti

segments.en:
'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stand a thousand vulture-feathered arrows, with a golden mouth,
with a horn shaft, with a brass tail, and well-made. They go through
the heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly space upon
the skulls of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 在廣大牧場之主密特拉的戰車一側，站著一千支禿鷲羽毛的箭，金色的箭頭，角質的箭桿，銅製的箭尾，製作精良。它們穿過天界空間，它們墜落天界空間，落在達埃瓦的頭骨上。

hukeretanãm,

mainyavaså pateñti

mainyavaså pateñti

segments.en:
'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stand a thousand spears well-made and sharp-piercing. They go
through the heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly space
upon the skulls of the Daevas.
'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stand a thousand steel-hammers, two-edged, well-made. They go
through the heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly space
upon the skulls of the Daevas.

'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stand a thousand swords, two-edged and well-made. They go through
the heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly space upon
the skulls of the Daevas.
'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stand a thousand maces of iron, well-made. They go through the
heavenly space, they fall through the heavenly space upon the
skulls of the Daevas.

segments.en:
'On a side of the chariot of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
stands a beautiful well-falling club, with a hundred knots, a
hundred edges, that rushes forward and fells men down; a club
cast out of red brass, of strong, golden brass; the strongest
of all weapons, the most victorious of all weapons. It goes through
the heavenly space, it falls through the heavenly space upon the
skulls of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 在廣大牧場之主密特拉的戰車一側，站著一柄美麗的、落勢優美的棍棒，有百個節，百個刃，衝鋒向前、擊倒人類；一柄由赤銅鑄成的棍棒，強韌的、黃金銅鑄的；所有武器中最強的，所有武器中最勝利的。它穿過天界空間，它墜落天界空間，落在達埃瓦的頭骨上。

the men who lied unto Mithra, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
drives forward through Arezahe and Savahe, through Fradadhafshu
and Vidadhafshu, through Vourubareshti and Vouru-jareshti, through
this our Karshvare, the bright Hvaniratha.
segments.zh: 他擊倒達埃瓦之後，他擊倒向密特拉說謊的人類之後，廣大牧場之主密特拉驅車穿過阿雷札赫和薩瓦赫，穿過弗拉達赫夫舒和維達赫夫舒，穿過沃魯巴雷什提和沃魯‧賈雷什提，穿過這個我們的卡爾什瓦雷，光明的赫瓦尼拉塔。

the evil-doing Peshotanu, flees away in fear; the long-handed
Bushyasta flees away in fear; all the Daevas unseen and the Varenya
fiends flee away in fear.
segments.zh: 安格拉‧曼紐，全是死亡者，驚恐地逃遁；埃什瑪，為惡的佩紹坦努，驚恐地逃遁；長臂的布什亞斯塔驚恐地逃遁；所有看不見的達埃瓦和瓦雷尼亞的惡魔驚恐地逃遁。

segments.en:
'Oh! may we never fall across the rush of Mithra, the lord
of wide pastures, when in anger! May Mithra, the lord of wide
pastures, never smite us in his anger; he who stands up upon this
earth as the strongest of all gods, the most valiant of all gods,
the most energetic of all gods, the swiftest of all gods, the
most fiend-smiting of all gods, he, Mithra, the lord of wide pastures.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
哦！願我們永遠不要遭逢盛怒中廣大牧場之主密特拉的衝擊！願廣大牧場之主密特拉永遠不在怒火中擊殺我們；他挺立在這大地上，是所有神中最強的，所有神中最英勇的，所有神中最精力充沛的，所有神中最迅捷的，所有神中最擊滅惡魔的，他，廣大牧場之主密特拉。
為了他的光輝和榮耀，我將向他獻上值得被聽聞的祭祀……

'If Mithra takes his libations to his own dwelling, "Happy
that man, I think," -- said Ahura Mazda, "O holy Zarathra!
for whom a holy priest, as pious as any in the world, who is the
Word incarnate, offers up a sacrifice unto Mithra with bundles
of baresma and with the [proper] words.
'"Straight to that man, I think, will Mithra come, to visit
his dwelling,
segments.zh:
「如果密特拉將他的奠酒帶到他自己的住處，『我認為，』阿胡拉‧馬茲達說道，『那人是幸福的，持阿沙的聖者啊！那人為之獻祭於密特拉的，乃是世間最虔誠的聖祭司，言語的化身，獻上一束束的勃雷斯瑪及以（正當的）言詞。
『我認為，密特拉將直接前往那人的住處，去訪問他的住所。如果他對他懷有任何厭惡，或對他的思想懷有任何厭惡，

segments.en:
'"When Mithra's boons will come to him, as he follows
God's teaching, and thinks according to God's teaching.
'"Woe to that man, I think," - said Ahura Mazda, - "O
holy Zarathushtra! for whom an unholy priest, not pious, who is
not the Word incarnate, stands behind the baresma, however full
may be the bundles of baresma he ties, however long may be the
sacrifice he performs."
segments.zh:
『當密特拉的福佑隨著他追隨神的教導、按照神的教導思想時，降臨於他。
『我認為，那人是不幸的，』阿胡拉‧馬茲達說道，『持阿沙的聖者啊！那人為之獻祭的，乃是不聖潔的祭司，並非虔誠，非言語的化身，此人雖然在勃雷斯瑪後面，不論他綁束的勃雷斯瑪如何充裕，不論他所作的祭祀如何冗長。」

'He does not delight Ahura Mazda, nor the other Amesha-Spentas,
nor Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, he who thus scorns Mazda,
and the other Amesha-Spentas, and Mithra, the lord of wide pastures,
and the Law, and Rashnu, and Arstat, who makes the world grow,
who makes the world increase.
'For his brightness and glory, I will offer him a sacrifice worth
being heard....
segments.zh:
『他不能使阿胡拉‧馬茲達喜悅，不能使其他大天神喜悅，不能使廣大牧地之主密特拉喜悅，他輕視馬茲達、輕視其他大天神、輕視廣大牧地之主密特拉、輕視法律、輕視拉什努、輕視阿爾斯塔特──使世界生長、使世界增進的神。
『因著他的光輝和榮耀，我向他獻上一個值得被聽聞的祭祀。」

he is the strongest of the strongest, he is the most intelligent
of the gods, he is victorious and endowed with Glory: he, of the

undeceivable god.

being heard....

『勝利而配備精製妥善的武器，在暗中警覺而不可欺騙。他是最強中的最強者，他是強中的最強者，他是諸神中最聰慧的，他勝利而被賦予榮耀：他擁有萬隻眼睛，擁有萬個間諜，這強大的、全知的、不可欺騙的神。

Tistrya; whose chariot is embraced by that goddess who is foremost
amongst those who have no deceit in them, O Spitama! who is fairer
than any creature in the world, and full of light to shine. I
will worship that chariot, wrought by the Maker, Ahura Mazda,
inlaid with stars and made of a heavenly substance; (the chariot)
of Mithra, who has ten thousand spies, the powerful, all-knowing,
undeceivable god.

being heard....

the trees that yield up baresma. We sacrifice unto Mithra, the
lord of all countries.
